Hi! I’m Evelyn (20), and I'm a Korean university student currently on a gap year.
I'm working in Cafe in East Brisbane and seeking a tidy, friendly home.
I’m very clean and communicative, and since I have experience living in a dormitory, I’m well-aware of shared house etiquette. I saw your listing and would love to inquire if the room is still available.
I'm looking to stay for about 6 months starting from 14th Mar.
Looking forward to hearing from you. Thank you!
I'm interested in the room for $270/pw. Would it be possible to arrange an inspection?
